title: A feeling that is not felt makes no sense

statements.text: There need not be something it is like to perceive or to learn, but an unconscious feeling, a feeling that is not felt, makes no sense. So it is reasonable to ask why visual processing does not go on in the dark, but not why affective arousal does not. The function of affect is barely distinguishable from its feeling.

sources.quote: There is not necessarily "something it is like" to perceive and to learn, but who ever heard of an unconscious feeling
How can affective arousal (i.e., the arousal of feeling) go on without any inner feel?
The function of affect is barely distinguishable from its feeling.
